decision_notes: Organic Act sections 10-11 establish the unicameral territorial legislature and broad local legislation and taxation powers; section 20 supplies appropriations authority. Statutory limits do not turn it into a municipal body. Evidence: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/COMPS-1142/pdf/COMPS-1142.pdf
Unincorporated territory of the United States; the map uses Guam itself as the territorial parent, with a separate United States search association.

The institutional homepage reports no live legislative broadcast; on-air coverage is untested.
